availability: Production server is not configured. Offline racing is available.
release_notes: Controls: new default DRAG TO STEER. Touching or holding alone never selects a steering angle; slide left/right from touchdown, slide back to straighten, lift to center.
Controls: proportional travel, touch-jitter threshold and vertical-swipe rejection. One steering finger keeps ownership while separate fingers operate gas, brake and drift.
Controls: mouse click-drag in the mobile layout, touch-emulated mouse deduplication, cancellation/focus/pause cleanup and one-time migration preserving player settings.
Bug fix: deferred menu layouts no longer retain freed panels during fast transitions or pause/exit.
Map: loaded scenery follows small camera turns every rendered frame, fixing stale-frustum edge pop-in; detail loading retains its existing 250 ms budget and source fence mapping remains intact.
Graphics and physics: original native desktop assets, shared handling and protocol 4 are preserved. Physical Android graphics, FPS and human controls remain unverified.
limitations: Physical Android installation testing remains incomplete.
Physical Android + Windows multiplayer testing remains incomplete.
Physical Android Low/Medium/High graphics qualification remains incomplete.
Final Android Low/Medium/High rendering, touch, lifecycle and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified.
Public multiplayer is not provisioned. Render integration is not connected; localhost gateway tests do not establish internet cross-play.
Free Render shared CPU capacity, cold wake and eight simultaneous human clients remain unmeasured.
Automatic content updates support signed allowlisted images; map geometry, audio and application code use complete packages.
